status: Research requirements, not implemented parity or measured speedups
coverage: Capability families based on selected source/doc review. Individual handlers and every UI state are not exhaustively reviewed.

families.name: Product discovery and download
families.upstream_user_outcome: Localized static marketing home/download pages, platform/store routing, stable/nightly releases, legal/security pages, SEO/unfurl metadata, install entrypoints.
families.rust_requirement: Rust-generated static HTML and CSS with progressive interactive controls. Preserve links, locale routes, metadata and useful no-app-runtime content.

families.name: Install and first launch
families.upstream_user_outcome: Desktop packages and package managers; self-contained CLI archives; browser-only use; phone links to host; provider setup can follow first launch.
families.rust_requirement: Rust launchers and platform packages, archive verification, collision-safe PATH integration, first-run setup and diagnosis. Preserve existing installation ownership.

families.name: Connection and account onboarding
families.upstream_user_outcome: Local pairing, hosted Connect, device approval/headless OAuth, provider account setup, guest route, resume links and environment catalog selection.
families.rust_requirement: Shared Rust auth/navigation state machines plus browser and OS credential/callback adapters. Do not collapse distinct trust scopes or host-specific credentials.

families.name: Workspace navigation
families.upstream_user_outcome: Projects, drafts, threads, linked threads, multiple environments, settings and modal overlays; preserve active view state and route/deep-link identity.
families.rust_requirement: Shared typed navigation model, separate DOM/native navigators, stable IDs, history/back behavior, focus restoration and cached views.

families.name: Responsive workspace
families.upstream_user_outcome: Desktop panes and windows; phone, tablet and fold/adaptive mobile layouts; touch, hardware keyboard, safe areas and OS back behavior.
families.rust_requirement: Native window/layout/gesture adapters and responsive web layout. Retain selections, draft and scroll anchors through resize, folds, rotation and process recreation.

families.name: Streaming conversation
families.upstream_user_outcome: Messages, tool/work-log events, collapsible history, code, citations, find, jump, minimap and follow-end behavior.
families.rust_requirement: Incremental shared conversation projection, visible-item virtualization, block-level Markdown cache, native/DOM renderers and semantic accessibility tree.

families.name: Rich composer
families.upstream_user_outcome: Exact Markdown editing, chips, file and thread context, model/skill commands, source-offset selection, rich clipboard, undo/redo, IME and large-paste attachments.
families.rust_requirement: Rust document model with explicit byte/UTF-16/grapheme conversions and platform text input adapters. A basic multiline editor does not cover this contract.

families.name: Send, queue, steer and rewind
families.upstream_user_outcome: Provider-dependent queue/steer, edits to queued work, pause/resume, remembered prompts, stashes, quote comments, rewind and safety around checkpoint restore.
families.rust_requirement: Typed intent/receipt and local-draft/outbox state machines with equivalent provider capability gating and cancellation semantics.

families.name: Files, code editing and diff review
families.upstream_user_outcome: Workspace tree, file navigation/edit/save, line references, syntax highlighting, split/unified diffs, collapsed/viewed files, review comments and scroll restoration.
families.rust_requirement: Rust text/diff/search core, incremental edits, worker scheduling and visible-row rendering. Keep external-file read-only policy and pending-edit reconciliation.

families.name: Git and worktrees
families.upstream_user_outcome: Branches, changes, commit/review/merge actions, isolated tasks, multi-repository projects and external editor integration.
families.rust_requirement: Shared Rust Git operation contracts and host adapters; preserve operation ownership, branch/worktree references, remote links and exact confirmation/error outcomes.

families.name: PR and issue workflows
families.upstream_user_outcome: PR/MR discussion, review drafts/threads/guides, checks/actions, viewed state, labels/reviewers/reactions, stacks and issues with host-specific capability differences.
families.rust_requirement: Shared Rust query/mutation/cache core, optimistic UI with reconciliation, host adapters and offline cached detail. Preserve host/account routing and action ambiguity behavior.

families.name: Terminal state and rendering
families.upstream_user_outcome: Ghostty VT state, scrollback, alternate screens, selection/copy/links, IME, mouse/focus protocols, resize, shell launch and reconnect.
families.rust_requirement: Native and WASM terminal core plus platform input and renderer adapters; preserve parser/replay state and unsupported-protocol behavior. Benchmark against current Ghostty, not an assumed JS terminal.

families.name: Terminal transport and lifecycle
families.upstream_user_outcome: Bounded attach history, streaming output, stopped terminal resume, transient disconnects, binary/control data, server query replies, ordered native writes.
families.rust_requirement: Sequence-aware bounded buffers and flow control. Apply a cursor only after native rendering accepts the write, handle partial-write failure through bounded reset/replay.

families.name: Attachments and media
families.upstream_user_outcome: Images, camera/share input, files, large pasted text, audio/video, PDF, tables, archives, supported Office formats and SQLite viewer.
families.rust_requirement: Rust media/document pipeline where practical, OS decoders/viewers and browser components where required, bounded bytes/caches, cancellation and source-owned access grants.

families.name: Voice
families.upstream_user_outcome: Draft dictation and annotation; selected on-device/environment/cloud destination, permissions, review before send, captured selection, cleanup and cancellation.
families.rust_requirement: Rust capture/session core plus Apple/Android/audio/model/provider adapters. Preserve explicit destination selection and concurrent-draft protection.

families.name: SnapShot
families.upstream_user_outcome: OS screen capture and permissions, global shortcut routing, capture animation/selection, clipboard/context attachment and suppressed shortcuts.
families.rust_requirement: Native capture/permission/window/shortcut adapters; preserve target workspace and attachment ownership. Detailed capture implementation remains an audit gap.

families.name: Interactive HTML and MCP Apps
families.upstream_user_outcome: Self-contained scripted HTML replies on all clients, theme/fullscreen/zoom, embedded attachments, MCP app tool calls and thread messages with existing approval scope.
families.rust_requirement: Keep a real browser sandbox and app bridge, implemented from Rust-owned host logic. Native drawing alone cannot execute these user capabilities.

families.name: Browser preview
families.upstream_user_outcome: Environment-owned browser tabs, local desktop rendering of remote-loopback sites, streamed remote tabs, mobile local WebView, user/agent control, popups/files/clipboard/annotations.
families.rust_requirement: Browser-engine/OS-WebView host, per-environment storage and tunnel routing, visible-tab stream scheduling, input ownership and security boundaries.

families.name: Device preview
families.upstream_user_outcome: iOS simulator/Android device discovery and streamed interaction, setup/download, screenshot/recording, picture in picture and agent access gating.
families.rust_requirement: Rust orchestration plus device SDK/codec/OS UI adapters, exact visible-session lifetime and input/permission behavior.

families.name: Remote environment operations
families.upstream_user_outcome: SSH setup and credentials, Tailscale/LAN, WSL runtime and path handling, linked environment grants, external editors, provider management on correct host.
families.rust_requirement: Rust host services and platform adapters with preserved host ownership, access choices, callback/shell quoting and failure behavior.

families.name: Offline and local persistence
families.upstream_user_outcome: Mobile cached shell/history/PR data, drafts/outbox/attachment files, browser IDB/localStorage, encrypted catalogs and client trust changes.
families.rust_requirement: Shared Rust schemas/state transitions, distinct platform durable stores and key management; migrate existing state atomically and preserve offline edits, not just server records.

families.name: Notifications and background activity
families.upstream_user_outcome: Push completion/failure/approval alerts, quiet foreground behavior, thread deep links, iOS Live Activities/widgets and Android ongoing/live status.
families.rust_requirement: Native APNs/FCM/system-extension/background adapters with account/environment scoping. Background restrictions and widget lifecycles are product requirements.

families.name: Accessibility and text input
families.upstream_user_outcome: Logical F6 focus cycling, roving keyboard navigation, shortcut precedence, context menus, screen-reader chip actions, reduced motion, CJK and mixed Unicode.
families.rust_requirement: DOM semantics for web plus native accessibility/text APIs for every native renderer. Preserve selection/caret/IME/focus, not merely visual parity.

families.name: Preferences, policy and diagnostics
families.upstream_user_outcome: Extensive per-client/per-environment settings, provider accounts, theme/language/keybindings, permissions, storage tools, diagnostics and managed policy.
families.rust_requirement: Typed configuration ownership and policy locks, locale catalogs, migration, recoverable settings forms and privacy-aware diagnostics. Each settings route remains in acceptance scope.

families.name: CLI human and machine interface
families.upstream_user_outcome: Default/start/serve, project/thread control, pair/auth, environment, browser setup, service/update/install/uninstall, connect/up/status, doctor/theme/trace/policy/triage and private helpers.
families.rust_requirement: Rust argument parsing and services with stable command names, JSON/stdout/stderr, stdin, TTY/color, exit and hidden-helper protocols.

families.name: Desktop shell integration
families.upstream_user_outcome: Native folders/files/context menus, external URLs, file drag, system permissions, native encrypted credentials, window activation, PATH and WSL integration.
families.rust_requirement: Rust desktop host replaces Electron glue while retaining platform-specific behaviors. Windows, Wayland/X11 and macOS need separate acceptance.

families.name: Updates and crash recovery
families.upstream_user_outcome: Desktop/CLI release channels and update rollback; mobile compatible OTA, safe reload after durable drafts/outbox, background timing and restart diagnostics.
families.rust_requirement: Rust updater/launcher with coherent owned-state backup and rollback plus native mobile packaging/update design. Native binary replacement cannot simply inherit JS OTA semantics.

families.name: Guest collaboration
families.upstream_user_outcome: Time-limited guest browser links, recent read-only history, guest requests awaiting owner dispatch, attachment limits, revoke/archive/unlink termination.
families.rust_requirement: Rust authorization/guest state plus web guest UI, request delivery and owner controls. Retain scoping and explicit owner approval.

families.name: Compatibility and external formats
families.upstream_user_outcome: Provider-native SQLite/transcripts, external SDK state, arbitrary user websites and HTML/JS apps, OS protocols, legacy install/runtime state.
families.rust_requirement: Rust-owned implementations use documented adapters. Preserve external formats and permissions; a Rust product does not authorize rewriting provider-owned databases or the browser engine.

families.name: Documentation and support
families.upstream_user_outcome: User setup/action docs, provider and remote troubleshooting, operational deployment/signing/release runbooks, legal/security routes and schema/document discovery.
families.rust_requirement: Preserve and update docs alongside behavior. Documentation and generated HTML are deliverables; deleting them is not a language migration.
